name: BioMini Plus 2
tagLine: High-accuracy USB fingerprint scanner for enrolment and desktop verification.
summary:
The BioMini Plus 2 is a compact, high-performance USB fingerprint scanner designed for biometric enrolment stations, customer-facing kiosks and desktop identity verification. With a large 16 × 19 mm optical sensor and FBI PIV-certified algorithm, it captures high-quality fingerprint images even from dry, wet or worn fingers — a critical requirement in South Africa's diverse workforce population.

Plug-and-play via USB, the BioMini Plus 2 ships with a comprehensive SDK supporting Windows, Linux and Android, making it straightforward to embed into HRMS, banking, KYC and government identity applications.

features.title: FBI PIV certified
features.description: Meets FBI Image Quality Specification (IQS) and FIPS 201 personal identity verification standards.

features.title: Large optical sensor
features.description: 16 × 19 mm capture area handles all finger sizes with a 500 dpi resolution for crisp, detailed images.

features.title: Dry, wet & worn finger support
features.description: Advanced image processing ensures reliable capture across the full range of skin conditions.

features.title: Cross-platform SDK
features.description: Comprehensive SDK for Windows, Linux and Android with sample code, documentation and technical support.
